subject: general
question: Allah Rakha was associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Alla Rakha Qureshi**, popularly known as **Allah Rakha** was an Indian tabla player who specialized in Hindustani classical music.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749cda184c539aba8b139bdb431fac1e6f157666a90f3164a50e62b553fc0a35.png] 
 
• He was a frequent accompanist of **sitar **player **Pandit Ravi Shankar **and was largely responsible for introducing Tabla to the Western audience.
 
• Despite opposition from his family, Allah Rakha left home at age 12 to learn tabla under the great master (ustad)** Mian Qadir Baksh**.
 
• He also trained under **Ashik Ali Khan**, a vocalist admired especially for his mastery of the khayal Hindustani song repertoire.
